name: Proxmox VE
description: Reads your Proxmox VMs and containers so the map and device pages show which devices run on which Proxmox host. Read-only.
author: Netlens

releases.changelog: Now an ordinary plugin (it was built into Netlens before 0.4.44). Same code as the built-in version 1.4.0; Netlens installs it again by itself for existing setups.
